title: notify-prefs.json
description: The notification preferences the desk declares: the DND choice. Split from notifications.json (LEO-281) so a file is never half config and half history — the history is the observation, this is the desk saying what it should do.

dnd.description: Do-not-disturb: toasts are suppressed (the history still records everything). Toggled from the panel or the bar bell; criticals break through unless the mode's routes say otherwise.
